# test_sacf_bp_bootstrap {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
test_sacf_bp_bootstrap(data, n_boot, w; alpha, block_size)
```
Compute a bootstrap hypothesis test for the BP-SACF statistic with window `w` and return a [`SACFBPTestResultBoot`](SACFBPTestResultBoot.qmd) with the bootstrap critical value, p-value, and reject decision.
 
Unlike [`test_sacf_bp()`](test_sacf_bp.qmd), this does not rely on the asymptotic χ²(2w(w+1)) distribution and is therefore more reliable for small images or large `w`.
 
  * `data`: the 2D image (M × N matrix).
  * `n_boot`: number of bootstrap replications.
  * `w`: lag window size (lags up to w in L∞ norm).
  * `alpha`: significance level (default `0.05`).
  * `block_size`: set `> 1` for a 2D block bootstrap that preserves spatial dependencies.


:::
